info.title: Galung.id Platform API
info.description: Contract for Galung Basic/Pro MVP, manual bank transfer only. Draft for engineering review; no payment gateway. JSON is camelCase while PostgreSQL is snake_case. Phase 00 reconciliation draft; terms are fixed 30 or 365 elapsed UTC days. Commercial values and protocol interoperability remain unapproved.

Activate with one-time secret and device attestation
post.description: One-use claim plus short-lived challenge and device-key proof. Enforce owner linkage, rate limit and seat cap transactionally. Return JWS and rotating opaque refresh credential once.

Bearer is the current device-bound refresh credential; validate PoP challenge and rotate credential atomically. JWS exp is at most the last genuine online validation plus 336 hours and effective entitlement end. Exact idempotent retry may return encrypted cached response; credential reuse otherwise revokes family.

cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly Secure server session. Mutations additionally require CSRF verification.

acceptedTermsVersion.description: Must match server-published text version and logged content hash.

pdfDownloadUrl.description: Short-lived signed URL or controlled download endpoint.

accountNumber.description: Sensitive; only disclosed to authenticated owner via invoice, no logs or analytics.

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL host outside API, never log; whitelisted upload destination.

bankCreditId.description: Required only for approval; must represent verified bank funds.

deviceProof.description: Signature over the approved canonical request, challenge and body hash.

signedToken.description: Compact JWS, device-bound and readable; no secret claims.

refreshCredential.description: Rotated opaque secret returned once; exact retry behavior in licensing protocol.

DevicePublicKeyJwk.description: Draft P-256 device proof key; Windows interoperability approval pending.

OfflineEntitlementClaims.description: Claims inside compact JWS with protected alg=EdDSA, typ=galung-offline+jwt and pinned kid. All times Unix seconds.
